content_blocks.title: Work through the example
content_blocks.text: Read the small example, predict every output line, then run it locally with a compatible runtime. Uses a temporary file, not a project path; close resources even after failures. The host may restrict I/O libraries. Keep the smallest reproducible case if the observed behavior differs.

content_blocks.code:
local file = io.tmpfile()
assert(file, "could not create temporary file")
file:write("Lua data\n")
file:seek("set")
print(file:read("*l"))
file:close()

items.title: Mistake 1
items.text: Confusing Code Style and Formatting with a similarly named feature in another language or runtime. Fix: follow the version-matched reference and test the smallest example.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.text: Relying on an output order or environment capability that the language/host does not guarantee. Fix: document assumptions and make order/capabilities explicit.

items.text: Skipping a boundary test or failing to check error-return values. Fix: test invalid and boundary inputs and inspect failure values.
